label: a test load of the database

sources.name: Contracts Finder (UK)
sources.covers: Open UK public sector tenders published on Contracts Finder, mostly English contracts from about 12,000 pounds up to the Find a Tender threshold.
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

sources.name: Delaware open bids
sources.covers: Open bids posted by Delaware state agencies, school districts, and colleges on the Delaware Bids marketplace.
sources.attribution: Source: Delaware Office of Management and Budget, Government Support Services, via data.delaware.gov
sources.cadence: Weekly at the source; checked daily
sources.notes: The dataset gives the due day only; we set the close to the end of that day, Eastern time.

sources.name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal
sources.covers: Open and forthcoming European Union calls for proposals (Horizon Europe, Erasmus+, LIFE, CERV, Digital Europe, and more), EU external action grants, cascade funding calls, and calls for tenders from EU institutions.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (European Commission reuse policy, Decision 2011/833/EU)
sources.attribution: Source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal, European Commission

sources.name: Federal Register
sources.covers: Funding notices federal agencies publish in the Federal Register, such as notices of funding opportunity and applications for new awards, with deadlines read from each notice.
sources.license: Public domain (1 CFR 2.6: anyone may reproduce Federal Register material)
sources.attribution: Source: FederalRegister.gov, Office of the Federal Register

sources.name: Find a grant (GOV.UK)
sources.covers: UK government grants listed on GOV.UK Find a grant.
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.notes: Off: the content is under the Open Government Licence, but the service offers no API or open data export of its listings, and we do not scrape web pages. Turn on if GOV.UK publishes a feed.

sources.name: Find a Tender (UK)
sources.covers: Open UK public sector tenders above the procurement thresholds, from every part of the UK, published on Find a Tender.
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

sources.name: Grants.gov
sources.covers: Every federal grant and cooperative agreement notice, forecasts included, from all 26 federal grant-making agencies.
sources.attribution: Source: Grants.gov

sources.name: Illinois CDB upcoming construction bids
sources.covers: State construction projects the Illinois Capital Development Board expects to put out to bid soon, with estimated bid dates and cost ranges.
sources.attribution: Source: Illinois Capital Development Board, via data.illinois.gov
sources.notes: A forecast list: every row is forecasted until it leaves the list. The architect or engineer of record is not stored.

sources.name: IRS exempt organization registry (EO BMF and Publication 78)
sources.covers: Every organization the IRS recognizes as tax exempt, with its 501(c) subsection and whether gifts to it are deductible, for checking an applicant's status by EIN.
sources.attribution: Source: Internal Revenue Service

sources.name: IRS Form 990-PF (private foundations)
sources.covers: Private grantmaking foundations in every state from IRS filings, with how to apply, deadlines, typical grant sizes, and past grantees for the larger ones.
sources.attribution: Source: Internal Revenue Service
sources.cadence: Daily (detail for up to 2,000 foundations a run)

sources.name: Los Angeles RAMP open bids
sources.covers: Open bids, proposals, and qualification requests from City of Los Angeles departments (Public Works, LADWP, Airports, Harbor) and other agencies posting on RAMP.
sources.attribution: Source: City of Los Angeles, RAMP, via data.lacity.org
sources.notes: Close dates in this dataset are UTC.

sources.name: Montgomery County, MD solicitations
sources.covers: Active invitations for bids, requests for proposals, and informal solicitations from the Montgomery County, Maryland Office of Procurement, with construction and local small business reserve flags.
sources.license: Public information (Montgomery County Open Data Act, no restriction on use)
sources.attribution: Source: Montgomery County, Maryland, Office of Procurement, via dataMontgomery
sources.notes: Closing dates carry no time; we set the close to the end of that day, Eastern time.

sources.name: NASA NSPIRES
sources.covers: NASA research solicitations (ROSES and others) as listed in NSPIRES. Off: no sanctioned feed; NASA notices reach the catalog through Grants.gov.
sources.attribution: Source: NASA NSPIRES
sources.notes: Off: NSPIRES has no RSS, export, or API; its list loads through an undocumented script call. NASA notices are covered by Grants.gov (agency NASA-HQ).

sources.name: NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts
sources.covers: Active NIH funding notices (RFAs, program announcements, and PARs) with due dates, activity codes, and participating institutes.
sources.attribution: Source: NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts

sources.name: NIH RePORTER
sources.covers: Past NIH awards, summarized by institute, activity code, state, and fiscal year (counts, totals, and typical award sizes).
sources.attribution: Source: NIH RePORTER

sources.name: NSF Award Search
sources.covers: Past NSF awards, summarized by directorate, program, state, and fiscal year (counts, totals, and typical award sizes).
sources.attribution: Courtesy: U.S. National Science Foundation

sources.name: NSF funding opportunities
sources.covers: Every NSF program, solicitation, program description, and Dear Colleague Letter inviting proposals, with due dates, target dates, and accepted-anytime programs.
sources.attribution: Courtesy: U.S. National Science Foundation

sources.name: NYC City Record Online
sources.covers: Open solicitations from every New York City agency as published in the City Record, including construction and design work from DDC, DEP, Parks, NYCHA, and Health + Hospitals.
sources.attribution: Source: The City Record, NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services, via NYC Open Data
sources.notes: Procurement section, solicitation notices only. Award notices are skipped (they name vendors).

sources.name: SAM.gov Assistance Listings
sources.covers: Every federal grant and cooperative agreement program in the Assistance Listings catalog (formerly CFDA), with objectives, who may apply, and typical award ranges.
sources.attribution: Source: SAM.gov Assistance Listings

sources.name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities
sources.covers: Every federal contract notice still open for responses on SAM.gov: solicitations, combined synopses, presolicitations, sources sought, and special notices, one row per solicitation.
sources.attribution: Source: SAM.gov
sources.cadence: Hourly with a free SAM.gov API key, daily from the public extract without one
sources.notes: Backfill: the public daily Contract Opportunities extract, no key. Incremental: the Opportunities API v2 when SAM_GOV_API_KEY is set (a key with a SAM.gov role allows 1,000 requests a day; one without a role allows 10), otherwise the extract when it has changed.

sources.name: San Francisco open bids
sources.covers: Open bid events from San Francisco departments on SF City Partner, including Public Works, Recreation and Park, and Public Utilities construction packages.
sources.attribution: Source: City and County of San Francisco, Controller's Office, via DataSF
sources.cadence: Weekly at the source; checked daily

sources.name: SBIR.gov awards
sources.covers: Past SBIR and STTR awards, summarized by agency, branch, phase, program, state, and fiscal year (counts, totals, and typical award sizes).
sources.attribution: Source: SBIR.gov, U.S. Small Business Administration

sources.name: SBIR.gov solicitations
sources.covers: Open SBIR and STTR solicitations from all eleven participating agencies, with topic counts and open and close dates, for U.S. small businesses.
sources.attribution: Source: SBIR.gov, U.S. Small Business Administration

sources.name: Scholarships and fellowships, checked by hand
sources.covers: Well-known national scholarships and fellowships for U.S. students and individuals, each checked on the sponsor's official page.
sources.license: Facts from each sponsor's official page; links only
sources.attribution: Source: each sponsor's official program page
sources.notes: Federal notices already on Grants.gov and NSF solicitations are left to those connectors.

sources.name: TxDOT highway lettings
sources.covers: Texas Department of Transportation construction and maintenance contracts: those advertised for the next letting, and those scheduled to let in the coming twelve months.
sources.license: Public information (State of Texas open data)
sources.attribution: Source: Texas Department of Transportation, TxDOTCONNECT, via the Texas Open Data Portal
sources.cadence: Daily (the dataset refreshes several times a day)
sources.notes: One opportunity per controlling project (CCSJ), which is how TxDOT lets contracts. Projects not yet advertised are forecasted.

sources.name: USAspending.gov
sources.covers: Past federal contract and grant awards as yearly totals: how many awards, how much, and typical award sizes by NAICS code, Assistance Listing, agency, and state.
sources.license: Public domain (U.S. government data; free to copy, adapt, and redistribute, per usaspending.gov/about)
sources.attribution: Source: USAspending.gov, U.S. Department of the Treasury
sources.notes: Aggregates only. Rows count new awards by fiscal year of the original award date, with amounts obligated to date. Contracts outside construction and A/E count awards of $250,000 or more.

sources.name: World Bank procurement notices
sources.covers: Open invitations for bids and requests for expressions of interest on World Bank financed projects worldwide.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank Data Catalog dataset terms)
sources.attribution: Source: World Bank procurement notices
